summary: Verdera Energy Corp., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Notice of Annual General Meeting and Management Information Circular dated September 8, 2026, for an AGM to be held October 19, 2026, with a record date of September 8, 2026. The ordinary business includes receiving audited financials for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, electing directors, appointing De Visser Gray LLP as auditor, and ratifying the 2026 Equity Incentive Plan. The filing uses Canadian Notice-and-Access rules, equivalent to US proxy-delivery rules. No special-situation transaction, activist campaign, or forced management change is disclosed.
